description: Matkustaja-alusten aikataulu-, liikennöinti-, ja sijaintitietoja Helsingin ja Tallinnan välillä is a dataset listed in Open Data Finland, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Helsingin kaupunginkanslia. The dataset contains monitoring data collected during the FinEst Smart Mobility project (5.4.2018-15.3.2019) on passenger vessels Finlandia, Star, Megastar and Silja Europa operating between the West Harbour of Helsinki and the Port of Tallinn. Coverage: Helsingin kaupunginkanslia. The portal shows the English title as "Schedule and position data on passenger ferries trafficking between Helsinki and Tallinn" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Helsingin kaupunginkanslia. Its keywords include kyselyt, yritykset, surveys, companies. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-finland.
